# Vendored MD4C

- Upstream: <https://github.com/mity/md4c/archive/refs/tags/v0.6.0.tar.gz>
- Version: 0.6.0 (commit `7fc1815a5eeba2af7d6120a76202bf59f3b6e6e4`)
- Archive SHA-256: `4d151298125a81da3b2efa2e0eed8bdb7a9318569804e4fa4d7a2375ab83ef70`
- License: MIT; see [`LICENSE.md`](LICENSE.md).

Telar compiles the parser (`md4c.c`) and the HTML entity table (`entity.c`)
into `lib/telar-render`. The HTML renderer, `md2html`, tests and build files
are not vendored.

## Local changes

None.
